mutation_order: sorted bug category, round-robin category depth; first candidate with completed public and private failures
public_cases: first two original upstream literal assertions
private_cases: third original assertion plus at least six independently authored regressions; remove duplicate inputs
reference_policy: reference must pass every original public and private case with the frozen strict comparator; do not patch reference
model_independent_exclusion_policy: reference violates supported native JSON type/strict comparator or stated boundary requirements
generation_backend: Transformers SDPA BF16; sequential single-episode generation
primary_metric: mean single-episode private acceptance; not pass@3
